rationale.complete: Round 1 done: dated card and predictions; numbers-only raw scan of event and turn schemas; synthetic study at real counts with a pre-data amendment; detector on all 282 non-holdout days against 217 dated events; 35 replication period folders; 4 natives (NE14, NE40, NE43, NE45) with predictions written before the run; confirm.py frozen, guarded and dry-run; estimates rows. Missing: holdout run, per-channel calibrated thresholds, a presence rule for format markers.
rationale.faithfulness: Dated changes are the ground truth and the schema channel recovers them to the day with the changed fields named (NE14, NE17, NE45) at zero placebo false alarms; drive counters date both NE43 steps. Not higher: the pre-registered fused alarm is mixed (AUC 0.68, p 0.059) and miscalibrated (FAR 0.18 vs 0.05 synthetic), NE40 is missed, two undocumented recoveries are not blind, and only 34 placebo days exist. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G2 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Directly operator-usable: a schema diff is computable from any swarm's logs, costs nothing, had no false alarms and dated platform and provider API changes; plain drive counters date operator changes. The fused alarm itself is not ready.

one_line: A daily schema diff of log records dates platform and provider API changes to the day with zero placebo false alarms; the fused five-channel alarm is mixed (AUC 0.68) and too noisy (FAR 0.18).

models.note: Platform steps show as synchronous rule changes; behavior shifts rarely do
Content centroid shift detects goal steps (AUC 0.89)

v2.claim: A schema diff of the raw record is an operator-grade change detector: 0/34 placebo false alarms; it dates NE14, NE17 and NE45 to the day and found 6 undocumented provider API changes. The fused five-channel alarm is too noisy (18% false alarms, AUC 0.68); topic shift remains the goal detector (AUC 0.89)
v2.scope: 282 non-holdout days, 217 dated events; natives NE14, NE45, NE43, NE40

ladder.factor: ground truth agrees (documented events dated to the day)
penalty: fused-alarm predictions failed; S channel credit partly post hoc

v2.decision: monitor the raw record's schema to catch platform changes; use topic shift for goals

raters.claim: A daily record-schema diff (platform-wide new or retired field-name/type signatures) dates platform and provider format changes to the day with 0/34 placebo false alarms (NE14, NE17, NE45, six undocumented provider API changes); it does not see prompt-only or behavioral changes. Excluded: the fused five-channel alarm (FAR 0.18), NE40, M/O channels.

ladder.factor: partial calibrated null (real placebo days: S FAR 0/34, Wilson upper ~0.10; synthetic S FAR 0 but synthetic noise mis-sized for the fused alarm)
partial replication (NE14, NE17, NE45 plus six provider changes dated; S hit on documented scaffold_tool only 0.26)
